messages.subject: plots with labels?
parts:
Hello,

I have the following data.frame that I melted:

columns: Symbol, XVal, YVal1, YVal2

I also have a look up table: Symbol -> "some short text 1" and "some short text 2"


I want to plot (all on one plot) for each Symbol the two lines XVal vs. YVal1 and XVal vs. YVal2.
I want, for all symbols, XVal<->YVal1 to be of one color and XVal<->YVal2 to be of a different color.
I think I could manage all of that, but here is the tricky part.
Instead of a legend (which could be confusing, because there will be lines of the same color), I want to plot next to the line (very close to, it above or below) the text "short text 1" next to XVal<->YVal1 and "short text 2" next to XVal<->YVal2. Is that possible?

Thanks!
